notes.title: Trainz A New Era - 90% OFF - Now just $2.00
notes.content:
Trainz 12 will soon be removed from sale on the Steam Store. You will still be able to play the game but our official support period will end (after 9 years).

To ensure that you have an easy option to upgrade to one of our supported games, you can now purchase [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/315660/Trainz_A_New_Era/]Trainz A New Era[/url] for just [h2]$2.00[/h2] 
Sale begins April 16 10 a.m. PT

[h1]WHAT'S NEW IN TRAINZ A NEW ERA?
[/h1]
For Trainz 12 users, the biggest thing you will notice is the graphics engine has been completely overhauled. On a like-for-like setting, your performance will improve (but make sure you don't max everything out unless you have the latest and greatest hardware).

[previewyoutube=xobOFLZ-1E4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]IMPORTING CONTENT[/h1]
Do not try to import Trainz 12 builtin content directly into TANE (as it will show "missing textiure errors). Please follow [url=http://online.ts2009.com/mediaWiki/index.php/Help:Importing_Content]this guide to import your content[/url].

[h1]DLC IS OPTIONAL[/h1]
T:ANE come with four built-in routes and thousands more available for free on the DLS. We also provide a couple of hundred DLC items you can purchase IF YOU WANT TO. These items have been created by the community using the tools included in the game. The creators share the revenues from your purchases of DLC. If you don't wish to purchase anything, that's fine, and if you do, that's great.

[h1]T:ANE PLATINUM EDITION - 90% OFF[/h1]
Speaking of DLC, we've put together a huge [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/5306/Platinum_Edition_Bundle/]PLATINUM EDITION[/url] package with 90% OFF, so it's a great chance to experience more of what Trainz has to offer.

ENJOY

TRAINZ TEAM

notes.title: TS 12 SP1 Patch (61297) is now live.
notes.content:
[h1] Changelog: [/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed various bugs in Surveyor which would trigger a Trainz Crash.
[*] Fixed a bug where viewing asset dependencies of multiple assets in CM were showing some duplicate assets
[*] Fixed a bug where splines did not attach to tracks properly if laid in different directions.
[*] Fixed a bug where changing the property (appearance) of water in Surveyor made the water disappear temporarily.
[*] Fixed a bug related to highlighting text in Surveyor's text fields.
[*] Fixed a bug where the ruler move tool didn't select the ruler.
[*] Fixed a bug where ruler delete tool didn't let the user delete the ruler.
[*] Fixed a bug where the driver's list scroll buttons would not hide with F6
[*] Fixed a bug where some of the loco's wheels were not turning.

Note: Patch file size is around 97MB.

notes.title: Steam DLC Downloads
notes.content:
We have fixed a bug where users who purchased any DLC for Trainz Simulator 12 from Steam were unable to activate and download the content in their Steam Trainz Simulator 12 game client. 

To install any Steam purchased DLC please follow these steps:

1. Launch Trainz Simulator 12 and start the game from the launcher
2. Click Get New Content from the game's Main Menu
3. Click Redownload all purchases at the bottom of the page. 

This should initiate a download for any purchased DLC you have for the game obtained via Steam store. 

Please contact our helpdesk via http://support.auran.com/ if you require any further support with the Trainz product.

Regards,
Sidds

notes.title: Trainz Sim 12 - Service Pack 1 update
notes.content:
We're pleased to announce that the latest changes and updates are now available through your automatic Steam update. 

After applying this update there will also be a prompt to update your Trainz database. Please allow at least one hour to apply the update.

Changes include:
- In-game Downloadable Content (Payware and Freeware).
- Improved multi-player support.
- Updated support for tunnels, bridges, power lines etc (splines).
- Improved session workflow (rules, nesting, copying etc).
- Automatic thumbnail generation for routes and sessions.
- Rewritten train coupling physics.
- Improved CMP error detection and validation.

There is also a very long list of bug fixes and enhancements to all facets of Trainz. 

Please note that the update may affect your previously installed content. We recommend that if you have any issues after installing the update that you run Content Manager  > File > Extended Database Repair.

Also note that any pre-purchased DLC will automatically re-download  and re-install for the new build. You can cancel these downloads or disable them via the in-game Options Menu.
